compatibility.title: Project settings
compatibility.readOnly: Read-only: managing this configuration requires project management permission.
compatibility.accessUnavailable: Could not verify management permission. Editing is disabled.
compatibility.instanceSource: Workspace defaults and devices come from instance settings; knowledge uses its own access rules.
compatibility.noProject: This session has no project configuration. It uses instance defaults, session settings and workspace-local skills; a directory never implies project membership.
compatibility.unavailable: Configuration is unavailable: it may be inaccessible, missing, or temporarily unable to load.
compatibility.retirement: The canvas entry point has retired. Existing configuration, sessions and resources remain here; no data has been moved or deleted.
compatibility.noSessions: No sessions visible to you in this configuration.

title: Projects
defaultDirectoryHint: Default directory for new sessions only. Existing session directories stay unchanged.
noProjects: No projects yet. Create one to get started.
noProjectsVisible: No projects are shared with you yet. Ask a project owner or admin to add you.
projectListTruncated: Showing {{shown}} projects; {{hidden}} more hidden. Search to narrow the list.
repositoryPathDescription: An existing local directory; Git is optional
initPathDescription: Path where the new repository will be created
repoModeExistingDesc: Use an existing local directory without initializing or requiring Git
repoModeInitDesc: Create a brand new Git repository at the specified path
repoModeCloneDesc: Clone a remote repository to a local path
deleteProjectConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? This will remove all chapters, narrators, terminals, and containers. The original repository files will not be affected.
deleteProjectTypeName: Type the project name to confirm:
commandsDesc: Define slash commands available to all narrators in this project. Project commands override user commands with the same name.
commandRunBashFirstDesc: When enabled, using this command runs the Bash command below via the /bash flow before sending the prompt to AI. The Bash result is included in the same AI turn context.
commandBashCommandPlaceholder: e.g. git status --short. Supports {{input}} and parameter placeholders.
commandPromptPlaceholder: Enter the prompt text. Use {{input}} as a placeholder.
commandEmpty: No project commands. Add one to get started.
commandDuplicateName: A command with this name already exists
commandInvalidName: Command name can only contain letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores
routinesDesc: Enable or disable built-in commands and skills for this project. Override the global setting per routine.
routinesUnsupportedDesc: This backend runtime does not support project-level routine overrides.
skillsDesc: Skills are reusable instruction sets that provide domain-specific knowledge to narrators. Create and edit project skills here; new skills are saved to .narrafork/skills/<name>/SKILL.md by default.
skillsEmpty: No skills found. Create a project skill to get started.
proxyDomainDesc: Base domain for container proxy subdomains. Each container port gets a subdomain like {chapterId}-{service}-{port}.{domain}.
proxyDomainHint: Requires wildcard DNS: *.{domain} → server IP. For local dev, use *.localhost or configure dnsmasq.
proxyDomainInvalid: Please enter a valid domain (e.g. dev.example.com, without http:// or paths)
projectWhitelistDirsDesc: Directories auto-allowed for narrators in this project.
projectBlacklistDirsDesc: Directories blocked for narrators in this project.
projectCommandWhitelistDesc: Commands auto-allowed for narrators in this project.
projectCommandBlacklistDesc: Commands auto-denied for narrators in this project.
requireReviewBeforeMergeDesc: When enabled, chapters must have an approved review before they can be merged.
authRequiredMessage: This repository requires authentication. Please enter your credentials.

visibilityHint.private: Only the owner and invited members can reach this project.
visibilityHint.public: Any signed-in user can reach this project.

access.noMembers: No members yet. Only the owner can reach this project.
access.noOwner: This project has no owner, so only admins can change access.
access.readOnlyNotice: Only the owner, a manager or an admin can change project access.
